titles.title: Birch and Pine Tree, Pink

description: Three slender, pink forms branch out from the bottom center of this abstract composition to the top. They intersect with soft, transparent shapes in shades of dark green. Angular black and gray forms are visible on the upper right side of the image, while a patch of orangish yellow light glows on the upper left. The work resembles several trees or branches layered with foliage.
